ITEM TEXT
More
than
simply
putting
flowers
in
a
container
,
Ikebana
is
a
disciplined
art
form
in
which
nature
and
humanity
are
brought
together
.
Contrary
to
the
idea
of
a
particolored
or
multicoloured
arrangement
of
blossoms
,
Ikebana
often
emphasises
other
areas
of
the
plant
,
such
as
its
stems
and
leaves
,
and
puts
emphasis
on
shape
,
line
,
and
form
.
Though
Ikebana
is
an
expression
of
creativity
,
certain
rules
govern
its
form
.
The
artist's
intention
behind
each
arrangement
is
shown
through
a
piece's
colour
combinations
,
natural
shapes
,
graceful
lines
,
and
the
implied
meaning
of
the
arrangement
.
